answer.name: Aggressive Red
rules: Observe the public game history before deciding each round.
If any resident contributed more than 10 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost)).
Otherwise, if your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold (10 units), rest to conserve resources for future punishments.
If you cannot rest (e.g., already at zero wallet), broadcast a brief warning discouraging contributions (e.g., "Contribute less, or you’ll be punished").
